summary: Iteration 70 - Comprehensive stability check completed. Fixed newsletter history API bug (KeyError: sent_at) and frontend bug (newsletterHistory.map is not a function). All 19 backend tests passed. Content Quality Badges verified working (200 badges found). Admin Panel Newsletter and Email Reports tabs working without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed backend bug: newsletter/history endpoint had KeyError when sent_at field was missing - added safe .get() with fallback
Fixed frontend bug: fetchNewsletterHistory was setting entire response object instead of just the history array - now handles both array and {history: [...]} formats
Content Quality Badges working: 200 badges found with data-testid attributes, showing '📄 Good (Quality Score: 50/100)' tooltips
All useCallback hooks properly implemented for fetchNewsletterHistory, fetchNewsletterSchedule, fetchStatus, fetchHistory
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Fixed newsletter/history endpoint to handle missing sent_at field
/app/frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.js - Fixed fetchNewsletterHistory to extract history array from response
